title: The Leaked Question Paper
briefing_md:
Friday's Data Structures exam paper appeared as a photo in the class WhatsApp group at 8:05 PM on Thursday, the night before the exam.

The paper had been sealed in a steel cupboard in Room 204, the department office. The Dean wants the leaker found before morning.

Three people are being talked about:
• Rohan Verma, 24, the teaching assistant. He can enter Room 204 during the day. He says he left at 5 PM and was in the library until about 8:45.
• Nisha Rao, 20, the class representative and topper. She says she collected lab files with the professor at 6:50 and they left together.
• Gopal Bhatia, 55, the department clerk for 20 years. He says he left at 5:30.

Most students suspect Rohan, the teaching assistant. Who leaked the paper?

clue.label: The leaked photo
clue.title: What the photo shows
clue.text:
The photo shows the question paper lying on a desk.
Question 4 has a correction in red ink: “5 marks” changed to “6 marks”.

Prof. Anita Kapoor: “I made that correction in red pen at 6:30 PM.”

questions.question: When was the photo taken?
options: Before 5:00 PM
Before 6:30 PM
After 6:30 PM
We cannot tell at all

clue.label: Steel cupboard
clue.title: The cupboard in Room 204
clue.text:
• No scratches. The lock is not forced.
• Prof. Kapoor: “I locked the paper in the cupboard at 6:45 PM.”

questions.question: How was the cupboard opened?
options: It was broken open with a tool
With a key
It was never locked at all
Through the back panel

clue.label: Keys
clue.title: Who holds a key
clue.text: Prof. Kapoor: “There are two keys. Mine was in my handbag all night. The spare key stays with Mr. Bhatia, the clerk.”

questions.question: What does this mean?
options: Any student could have opened the cupboard
Rohan has a key of his own
The cupboard does not need a key
Only the professor's key or the clerk's spare fits

clue.label: Library log
clue.title: Rohan's evening
clue.text:
Rohan Verma — IN 5:10 PM, OUT 8:45 PM.
The librarian confirms he did not leave.

The photo was posted at 8:05 PM.

questions.question: What does this tell us about Rohan?
options: He was in the library the whole time
He took the photo before going to the library
He left the library at 8:05 PM to post it
He was never in the library at all

clue.label: Professor's statement
clue.title: Nisha's evening
clue.text: Prof. Kapoor: “Nisha came at 6:50 to collect lab files. She was with me the whole time. We left together at 7:10. The paper was already locked away at 6:45.”

questions.question: What does this tell us about Nisha?
options: She had the cupboard key with her
She was never alone with the paper
She stayed back after the professor left
She took the photo at 6:50 PM

clue.label: Mugs
clue.title: A mug in the photo
clue.text:
• In the background of the leaked photo: a chipped green mug on top of the steel cupboard.
• Rohan's mug is blue and has his name on it.

questions.question: What does the mug tell us?
options: The photo was taken in the library reading room
The mug in the photo clearly belongs to Rohan
The photo was taken in Room 204; the mug is not Rohan's
The photo was taken at the professor's home

clue.label: WhatsApp group
clue.title: Who posted it
clue.text:
The photo was first posted at 8:05 PM by “Aman B.”, a student in the class.
Aman has no key to Room 204 or to the cupboard.

questions.question: What does this suggest?
options: Aman broke into the steel cupboard himself
Aman wrote the question paper
The professor sent it to the whole class
Someone with a key gave Aman the photo

clue.label: Timeline
clue.title: Thursday evening
clue.text:
6:30 PM — red-ink correction made
6:45 PM — paper locked in the cupboard
7:10 PM — Prof. Kapoor and Nisha leave Room 204
8:05 PM — photo posted in the class group

questions.question: When was the photo most likely taken?
options: Between 7:10 PM and 8:05 PM
Between 5:00 PM and 6:30 PM
Between 6:45 PM and 6:50 PM
After 8:05 PM

twist_md: New evidence has come in: the department visitor register, the clerk's desk, and a remark about the green mug.

clue.label: Visitor register
clue.title: Room 204, Thursday
clue.text:
Bhatia — OUT 5:30 PM
Nisha — IN 6:50 PM, OUT 7:10 PM
Bhatia — IN 7:40 PM, OUT 8:10 PM

Bhatia: “I came back at 7:40 only for my tiffin box and left.”

Next morning the tiffin box is still on his desk, unopened.

twist_questions.question: What is wrong with Bhatia's story?
options: He never came back to the office at all
He stayed 30 minutes and never took the tiffin
He left before Nisha and the professor arrived
Nothing is wrong with his story

clue.label: Desk drawer
clue.title: Inside the clerk's drawer
clue.text:
• The spare cupboard key, on a tag.
• Under it, a college notice: “Backlog list: Aman Bhatia, Data Structures, 2nd attempt.”

Aman is Mr. Bhatia's son.

twist_questions.question: What was the motive?
options: To help his son pass the exam
To sell the paper to students for money
To get the professor into trouble
To get Rohan removed from his job

clue.label: The green mug
clue.title: Whose mug is it?
clue.text:
Rohan: “Everyone knows the chipped green mug is Bhatia sir's.”

The photo was posted at 8:05 PM. Bhatia was inside Room 204 from 7:40 to 8:10 PM.

twist_questions.question: What most likely happened?
options: Rohan took the photo and blamed Mr. Bhatia
Nisha came back with the professor's key
Aman broke in while his father waited outside
Bhatia used the spare key and sent his son the photo

answer.explanation: Gopal Bhatia, the clerk, came back to Room 204 at 7:40 PM, opened the cupboard with the spare key, photographed the paper and sent it to his son Aman, who has a backlog in the same subject and posted it at 8:05 PM. The red-ink correction proves the photo was taken after 6:30 PM, the cupboard was not forced, and Bhatia's green mug is in the photo. His “I only came for my tiffin” story is false: he stayed 30 minutes and the tiffin was still on his desk next morning. Rohan was in the library from 5:10 to 8:45, and Nisha was with the professor the whole time.
